title: HIT MARKERS AND KILLS ARE HEARD
why: His number 45, punchy arcade sound like CoD and Fortnite. A round of yours that landed drew the X at the reticle in silence, and the hit sound itself plays out at the target, often far away and muffled, so in a fight you could not tell by ear whether you were landing. Now every landed round gives a crisp tick in your own ears (a weak spot a higher one), and a kill gives the tick, a low thunk and a two note ding. They play on the HUD bus, so they are never squashed, ducked or muffled by walls.
now: Landing a hit ticks in your ears and a kill rings, like CoD and Fortnite.
